newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's king flies to Gaza for talks with Arafat.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's king flies to Gaza for talks with Arafat.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan left Amman on Sunday for self-ruled Gaza to hold talks with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on stalled Israeli-Palestinian peace talks, a palace official said.

The Jordanian monarch, who visited the Palestinian-ruled town of Jericho last October, was making his first trip to Gaza, the official said. He was accompanied by Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti.
Palestinians say U.S.-brokered talks with Israel on Israeli troop withdrawals in the West Bank have reached a crisis over Israel's demand to delay further troop pull-backs scheduled for this year.
Washington's Middle East envoy Dennis Ross, mediating in talks for a long-awaited Israeli troop redeployment in Hebron, was due to leave the Middle East later on Sunday having failed to close a deal.
Ross said in Cairo on Saturday the two sides had "basically resolved" the Hebron issue, but Palestinians insist Israel commit itself to honouring the timetable for redeployment elsewhere.
